title: Production Data Contract
closure_basis: The contract scaffold exists, but required machine/material/process inputs are still missing.
objective: Define a stable machine/material/process contract that every later production phase can consume.
how_it_is_done: The optimizer result is normalized into a structured production program with explicit geometry, screening state, line configuration, inspection gates, and execution order.
The line configuration is checked recursively for missing leaf fields so the repo can distinguish between missing engineering data and missing code.
why_this_way: A production optimizer fails in practice when downstream tooling relies on implicit assumptions. The contract is explicit so machine, cure, and inspection phases all read the same object model.
The completeness check is recursive because later phases depend on deeply nested data such as heater limits, NDI method, and qualification evidence.
